In-memory arithmetic preserves the relative phases needed for coherent controls. The pinned QASM exporter omits the compiled circuit’s overall global phase, recorded in the ledger. Our QASM files describe complete measured trials with unchanged probabilities; they are not specifications for a phase-preserving oracle to be coherently controlled again.

per full trial. Its dependency depth is a compiler graph property, not physical runtime. Preparation, all arithmetic and uncomputation, inverse QFT and readout are included. The eight-trial contract charges 69,352 primitive operations including readout. Classical constant construction, continued fractions, modular exponentiation and gcd verification run on the classical processor; generated metadata records measured construction/compilation and seeded postprocessing timings, separately from physical projections. Their classical bit-complexity is polynomial using ordinary modular arithmetic. The enumerated order reference is bounded validation work and is not part of the algorithm.

success accounting. A general factoring driver also needs classical preliminary checks, random-base choices, noncoprime-base gcd successes, unfavorable periods, phase-precision selection and their combined success bound. Those parts are not projected by this report.

python scripts/generate_shor.py --physical

  --no-sim --no-scaling --output-dir artifacts/shor-33
The generator permits at most 12 input bits and 24 exponent bits, subject to a conservative arithmetic-work preflight and a 500,000 expanded-operation cap.
Statevector execution is separately capped at 18 total wires.
